svg.title: Gem5AccelBackend accelerator architecture
svg.desc: The host global fabric remains noncoherent. The accelerator has private 8 KiB L1I and 16 KiB L1D, split Code/Data TCM, and a 4 GHz coherent local crossbar. DMA reads snoop dirty L1D lines and writes clean/invalidate destination lines first.

g.text: gem5 accelerator backend · PDES proof of concept
backend = "gem5" · one gem5 process · host + eight accelerators
Event queue 0 · host, shared memory path, and all eight host adapters
Common quantum · packet ownership + retry / credit flow control
Event queue 1 · one accelerator shown in detail
One hart · no SMT or RVV
CoherentXBar · 4 GHz / 64 B · L1D snoops + DMA + MMIO
CPU + caches + DMA own local events
Host RAM and MMIO stay uncached
No CPU access to active DMA destinations
Private L1s: 64-byte lines · parallel 1-cycle tag/data lookup · no prefetcher.
Repeat for N accelerators; compare one queue with N+1 queues using identical modeled timing.
